##### Project general facts

Marquis One is a contemporary residential development that combines elegant architecture with thoughtfully designed living spaces. The project offers a collection of studios and multi-bedroom residences, including exclusive layouts with private pools, creating a refined residential environment tailored to modern lifestyles. Defined by its sleek architectural lines, expansive windows, and carefully planned interiors, Marquis One emphasizes natural light, spaciousness, and functional design while delivering a sophisticated living experience with a strong attention to detail.

Residents have access to a carefully curated selection of lifestyle amenities designed to support wellness, productivity, and relaxation. The development features a fully equipped fitness center with dedicated training areas, steam and sauna facilities, business and meeting lounges, and beautifully designed communal spaces that encourage both social interaction and quiet leisure. Every amenity has been thoughtfully integrated to create a comfortable and balanced residential environment.

The residences feature modern finishing using high-quality materials, creating elegant interiors with a contemporary aesthetic. Kitchens come fully equipped with integrated appliances, combining functionality with sleek design. All residences are delivered fully furnished, providing a stylish and move-in-ready home that complements the project's premium character.

##### Location description and benefits

Arjan is a thriving and rapidly developing district in Dubai, known for its well-planned layout, vibrant atmosphere, and proximity to some of the city’s most famous attractions. Located between Al Barsha South and Dubai Motor City, it offers seamless connectivity to key highways, making travel across the emirate quick and convenient. The area’s growing infrastructure and urban planning make it a prime location for both residents and investors seeking long-term value.

One of Arjan’s key advantages is its blend of modern residential communities and abundant green spaces. Home to landmarks like Dubai Miracle Garden and Dubai Butterfly Garden, the district offers a unique combination of city living and natural beauty. With schools, healthcare facilities, retail outlets, and leisure options within easy reach, Arjan provides everything needed for a comfortable and self-sufficient lifestyle.

The community is also known for its variety of residential projects, ranging from stylish apartments to upscale developments with premium amenities. This diversity attracts a mix of families, young professionals, and investors. With its strategic location, appealing surroundings, and continuous growth, Arjan stands out as one of Dubai’s most promising and desirable areas to live and invest in.
